title: Split injections of equal local rank are invertible
statement: For scheme maps f:X→S and j:W→S [def-pc-scheme], let E be an O_X-module and N an O_W-module. Suppose every w has an open neighbourhood U and r such that N|_U and E|_X_U are finite locally free of rank r [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. Any split monomorphism p^*N→q^*E, with p and q the base-change projections and tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], is invertible.

source.place: final paragraph, perfect pairing and the two displayed mutually dual bases

proof.text: Choose the supplied U and r at each w. The canonical X_U→X_W is an open immersion and these maps cover X_W. Pullback-composition isomorphisms identify both restrictions with rank-r modules.
On every stalk the source and target are finite free and have finrank r. Pullback preserves the retraction identity.

For a split injection a:M→N between equal-rank finite free modules choose a basis isomorphism e:M≃N. The retraction b is surjective; b∘e is a surjective endomorphism, hence injective by Module.End.injective_of_surjective. Thus b is injective, and b∘a=id forces a∘b=id. Stalkwise bijectivity proves each restricted sheaf map invertible, and the open cover reflects invertibility. Zero rank and the empty cover satisfy the same argument.

proof_origin.place: Refinement of the supplied local dual-basis plan; categorical transport and stalk argument
